name: lillietest
expr: [h1, p1, ks1, cv1] = lillietest(x_norm); [h2, p2, ks2, cv2] = lillietest(x_bi);
comment: Sig: [h, p, kstat, critval] = lillietest(x[, alpha]). Lilliefors normality test using Stephens (1974) p-value approximation. KS-stat bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b; p-value/critval may differ by ~1e-3 due to approximation table interpolation. h decision matches MATLAB on probed cases.
